data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly requires drawing on 'published definitions' to distinguish idempotent from safe operations. SRC_003 instead invents a novel term, 'effectively idempotent,' that is not drawn from any published source—its definitions, derivation, and formalization_refs arrays are all empty. Its own countercondition acknowledges this gap ('If the published literature defines idempotency strictly at the primitive operation level... then "effective idempotency" is not idempotency at all') but never resolves it, leaving it as a pending observation. The mechanism text is also truncated mid-sentence ('The published'), so the promised connection to published definitions is never delivered. Without grounding in published definitions, the target fails the problem's core requirement.
